translation:
However, even if we go back to question the
computer society again…

Those guys are pretty wary because of
Haruhi, right?
Won't they avoid being upfront with us…?
The possibility certainly isn't zero.

For the time being, how about we head their
way and try?

Of course, Miss Suzumiya wouldn't be pleased
if we came back without trying to ask them.

That's true… Anyway, we still need to go, even
if just to pretend we're doing something.

Heey, Kyon, are there any games or
anything?
Hey, why are you here?

When I looked over my shoulder, my little sister
was right behind me.
Weren't you supposed to stay with Haruhi?

Yeah, but this way seemed more fun, so I came
here.

I'd love to hear just what about this seemed
fun to her.
Hey Kyon, so are there any games?

As if I know. Even if there are some, we're not
going there to play.

Make sure to do what you're told, so you don't
become a nuisance.
Bleh, booooring.
Y-you guys again?! What is it this time?!

Well now, there's no need to be so cold, is
there?

Did you forget what your brigade chief did to
us?

If there's a single thing about her that's
friendly, I'd love to hear about it!

You're not wrong. If anyone asked me, I
wouldn't have anything nice to say.
Now now, Mr. Club President.
Huh? Koizumi?
Please entrust this to me.

Club President, neither of us hold any
hostility towards you.

Far from it, in fact. I think we should
collaborate with each other.

Don't you want to enjoy a better school life,
for both of our benefits?

Hm… really? I'm not in a very trusting mood,
but…

He really does seem to be a master of
persuasion, that Koizumi fellow.

It seems like the club president is gradually
getting into the mood to talk.

Not that listening to Koizumi's irritating talks
is any fun.

Though your research society is cultural, it's
rather unusual for you to camp at school.
Ah, well…

…I want you to keep this a secret from your
brigade chief, but…
It's not a problem.

Thanks a lot. I get the feeling that if that
person caught wind of this…
…something bad might happen…

Mr. President, that feeling is most likely
correct.
So then, why might you be camping at school?
Right…

We're making an original game for the cultural
festival.

A game you say? That sounds very
interesting.

I would definitely love to see it when it's
finished.
Geez, he really is impressive…

I don't get how he can line up all that irrita-
ting flattery without even batting an eyelid.
In a way, it's admirable.

Though of course, I have absolutely no
intention to do the same.

If I keep listening to Koizumi's flattery my
ears are going to bleed.

Is there nothing for me to pass the time with?
…Hm?
Was this also drawn on a computer?
Y-yes. That's right!
Woww, that's amazing.
Not at all… Hahaha.
Oi, what are you doing?
Ah, Kyon!

This poster is amazing! These people said
they made it on a computer!
Poster?

"Value the water!” Is this supposed to raise
awareness for water conservation?

It was a request from the student council.
They're pretty good, don't you think?

"H2O,” in other words "water,” is written on
the poster using CG, but…

Something about it gives a strange
impression. What's wrong with it exactly?
Ah.
What is it, Kyon?
Right here, isn't the "2” from "H2O” missing?
Huh?! …Ahh, you're right!

It's the same color as the background, so it's
impossible to see!

Also, somehow or another the "H” seems too
wide.
That's not an H…
It looks like "1-1.”
N-now that you mention it…
Oh, it was an H? I thought they wrote "1-10.”

…Certainly I couldn't say it doesn't look like it.
In other words, it does look like it.
This could be useful.

The poster doesn't convey the intended
message in its current state, right?

I think it'd be best if you took down the
posters you've put up so far.

It's summer vacation, so probably not many
students have seen it.

If you hurry and remake them, I'm sure
nobody will notice.

Uhh, maybe… I'll talk to the president about it
and we'll consider it…

He's disappointed, but maybe I could use this
as a means to trick Haruhi.
Hopefully this is enough to convince her.
I see. It seems like quite an interesting game.
Yes! We're really proud of it.

Koizumi's truly mastered the art of
conversation.

Not long ago, the club president's mouth was
firmly shut.

It's impressive that he softened him up so
much.

How about I give you guys a special
in-development screening…
Prez! Prez!
Hm, what is it?

I think the memory card with our program on it
has gone missing!
What?!

Wasn't it with us in the computer lab when we
were running tests?
Yeah, but it seems like I've lost it since then.
R-right… I'll go search for it in a bit.

He said "in a bit,” but it's clear from his
expression that he wants to go right away.

I don't really get it, but it seems like they've
lost something really important.

There probably isn't anything more to gain by
being here.

Koizumi, we've just about run out of time.
Let's head back.
Indeed, you're quite right.
Come on, you too.
I wanted to play moreee.
Just come already.
Well, see you later~!
See you~!

Before I knew it, my little sister seemed to
have taken a liking to the club members.

Good grief, I'm surrounded by hopeless
people.
Our harvest was pretty much fruitless, huh…
No no, that's not the case.

We were able to obtain some rather
interesting information.

It doesn't like it to me…
But I guess I'll take your word for it.
Me too, me too! It was interesting!
Okay okay. You can just be quiet.

Now that I think about it, they said they lost
their memory card.

Was that just made up so they wouldn't have
to show us their game?

No, it seems to be true. You could tell by the
look on their faces.
What's a "memo reecard”?

Here you go again, butting your head into
everything…
Hey hey, what is it?

It's a small and thin object, about this size
perhaps.
Hmm… Like that thing?
Hm? …Oh?!

Why is there a memory card lying in the corner
of the hallway?!
I see…

He must've accidentally dropped it when
putting up the posters in this area.

Should we return it? …Ah, hold on, what are
you doing?

This is conjecture based on what their club
president said, but…

Whatever the contents are, they certainly
don't want Miss Suzumiya to know about it.

That's how I interpreted their manner of
speaking, at least.
Doesn't it make you wonder what's inside?
…Are you suggesting we take it with us?

Only until our summer camp is over. Once we're
done with it, we'll return it.

You can't make an omelet without breaking
some eggs…right?
Precisely. I believe that's exactly the case.
I see… I'll act like I didn't see anything.

You take responsibility for the memory card,
Koizumi.

That was always my intention. I'm not planning
to get you in trouble.

If you're so inclined, how about I leave it with
Miss Nagato?
…I'll look after it.

Did Koizumi swindle me into doing this? Now I'm
complicit.

Right. In times like this we shouldn't be over-
looking something that could distract Haruhi.
Don't you think?
It's wonderful that you understand.

There must be something wrong with me if I
understand the way this guy thinks…
I knew Koizumi liked tabletop games, but…

The fact he also likes computer games makes
me think he's someone with a lot of hobbies.
I'm something of an omnivore.

If it seems interesting, I'm prone to get
involved in various things.
Isn't that just called being bored?
I mean, you're so easily amused by anything.
Hahaha, that's quite harsh, isn't it?

You're quite multifaceted yourself. You always
go along with whatever I suggest.
Am I wrong?
If you only look at the end results, I suppose.

But there were a few games in particular that
I wanted to focus on above the rest.

Then how about we play one of those games
again?
Yeah, one of these days.
Did you say something?
Not particularly.
I don't have any reason to chat with this guy.
Continue asking regardless
Look away
Close your eyes
Agree
Say it out loud
Just think it in your mind
